text:
maria_chen: Heads up — noticed a 'Burst Capacity Fee' line on the latest APAC invoice for asia-southeast2 GPUs (~$12,300). Tagging finance.
kevin_li: ack, pulling invoice now. Do you have the exact line item id?
maria_chen: it's `lineitem-APAC-BURST-202503` (on the PDF). Screenshot pasted in billing ticket: https://billing.example.com/t/12345
kevin_li: filing internal ticket with cloud support. Suspect provider rebilled for 'burst' capacity after autoscale spike. @raj_patkar can you check cluster autoscaler logs?
raj_patkar: looking. Saw a series of scale-ups last billing period due to a training job that hot-spun workers — but those were preemptible nodes, not dedicated. autoscaler logs: ```2025-02-28T22:10:12Z scale_up: add 48 gpu nodes``` ... continuing
olivia_smith: Finance: does our commitment/discount cover burst usage? We should check reserved capacity apportioning.
kevin_li: Our commitment covers steady reserved capacity up to 400 GPUs in apac; burst above that should be billed at on-demand. This charge looks like on-demand burst fee, but amount doesn't match expected rate.
maria_chen: cloud support responded: 'a rebilling adjustment applied to correct undercharged egress of GPU burst reservations — invoice line shows a 'Burst Capacity Fee' with code GPC-BURST-ADJ'. They've opened case CRE-7621.
raj_patkar: logs show an accelerator attach event followed by reattach after a maintenance window, which triggered a transient double allocation for ~17 minutes.
olivia_smith: double allocation could explain duplicate time-based charges. Any evidence of duplicate SKUs in the billing export? Can we get the raw CSV export for that billing period?
kevin_li: attached CSV to the ticket. Quick grep shows two line items with same resource id but different rate: ```resource_id=gpu-pool-asia-01, sku=GPC-BURST, amount=11982.00``` and ```resource_id=gpu-pool-asia-01, sku=GPC-BURST-OVERRIDE, amount=0.00``` weird override
maria_chen: provider claims override is a correction but the correction came after our invoice was finalized and they auto-applied both. I'm escalating for a credit.
raj_patkar: Can we backfill metrics to prove the extra allocation? I have node start/stop times for the window — will attach perf and prometheus snippets.
olivia_smith: please make sure to tag cost center 'inference-prod' on the ticket. Finance will need GL code to process any credit.
kevin_li: Opened an appeal with cloud support (case CRE-7621), requested pro-rated credit and corrected invoice. Also cc'ing account manager. ETA 48h.
maria_chen: thanks. Action items: raj to attach metrics + node timeline, olivia to prepare GL and internal memo, kevin to chase support. I'll pause any batch jobs hitting autoscaler thresholds meanwhile :pause_button:
raj_patkar: attached prometheus query results and node lifecycle timestamps to the ticket.
kevin_li: update from support: they acknowledge duplicate charge, creating a refund request. Will confirm in 24–72h.
maria_chen: great — set reminder to reconcile once credit posts. If they deny, we'll escalate to AM and consider reserved capacity reallocation to avoid autoscaler burst in APAC.
olivia_smith: noted. Also asking product to gate large experiments into staging for next month. :memo:
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-8812 referencing CRE-7621 — assigned to raj_patkar, priority P2.
kevin_li: thanks all. I'll update thread when refund is visible on next billing cycle.
